basicDetails.schemeName: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Seed spice thresher (nos)
basicDetails.briefDescription: To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated)

schemeContent.briefDescription: To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated)
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Seed spice thresher (nos) is implemented by the /Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated) The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
schemeContent.benefits_md: 1. 50 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹ 75,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹1,12,000/- per unit for NE/SC/ST & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subject to maximum of ₹ 1,35,000/- 1. Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG

children.text: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Seed spice thresher (nos) is implemented by the /Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India.
To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated)

The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).

50 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹ 75,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹1,12,000/- per unit for NE/SC/ST & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subject to maximum of ₹ 1,35,000/-
Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG
Registration
Step 1: The applicant should visit the
ServicesPlus
website.
Step 2: Click on the “
Register”
option on the homepage.
Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha.
Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form.
Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.”
Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email.
Login
Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on
“Login.”
Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha.
Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name.
Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form.
Step 5: Submit the application.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1.Preferably in all seed spice growing states and regions in India/UT. 2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases. 3. An individual grower having 0.40 ha and up to 8 ha is eligible to apply.
